Essentials.name: Auto Center Anchor Point
Essentials.description: Centers the layer anchor on current text/shape bounds. Offset is in layer pixels. Changing the anchor can move the artwork; Position is not compensated.

Text.name: Digital Clock
Text.description: Elapsed HH:MM:SS from the layer in-point.

Text.name: Number Counter
Text.description: Animate the Value slider to count. Decimals ranges from 0 to 6.

Text.name: Typewriter
Text.description: Types the layer’s text. Show Cursor toggles blinking; Cursor Style selects a vertical bar or underscore. Speed is characters/second, Blink Speed is cycles/second (0 stays visible).

Time.name: Loop Out
Time.description: Repeats after the last keyframe. loopOut: Cycle, Ping-pong, Offset, or Continue. Keyframe Count is intervals; 0 uses all keys. Continue ignores the span.

Time.name: Posterize Time
Time.description: Samples existing animation at the chosen frames per second.

Time.name: Loop In
Time.description: Move the first keyframe later than the layer in-point to see the loop before it. loopIn: Cycle, Ping-pong, Offset, or Continue. Keyframe Count is intervals; 0 uses all keys. Continue ignores the span.

Time.name: Loop Out Duration
Time.description: Repeats after the last keyframe. loopOutDuration: Cycle, Ping-pong, Offset, or Continue. Duration is seconds; 0 uses the AE default. Continue ignores the span.

Time.name: Loop In Duration
Time.description: Move the first keyframe later than the layer in-point to see the loop before it. loopInDuration: Cycle, Ping-pong, Offset, or Continue. Duration is seconds; 0 uses the AE default. Continue ignores the span.

Time.name: Auto Fade In / Out
Time.description: Fades the existing opacity at layer edges. Zero disables that fade; overlapping fades stay bounded.

Time.name: Random Time Offset
Time.description: Delays each duplicate’s own keyframed animation randomly. Max Delay is seconds.

Time.name: Stagger by Layer Index
Time.description: Cascades each layer’s own keyframes by its composition index. Delay is seconds; reordering layers changes timing.

Time.name: Loop with Offset
Time.description: Repeats after the last keyframe while accumulating change. Keyframe Count is intervals; 0 uses all keyframes.

Wiggle.name: Posterize + Wiggle
Wiggle.description: Stepped random motion. Amplitude uses the selected property’s units.

Wiggle.name: Wiggle Loop
Wiggle.description: Seamless random motion for a static base value. Duration is in seconds; animate the base separately if a seamless loop is not required.

Wiggle.name: Wiggle X-Axis Only
Wiggle.description: Wiggles only X; preserves the other coordinates, including Z.

Wiggle.name: Wiggle Y-Axis Only
Wiggle.description: Wiggles only Y; preserves the other coordinates, including Z.

Wiggle.name: Basic Wiggle
Wiggle.description: Random motion; amplitude uses the selected property’s units.

Wiggle.name: Oscillate
Wiggle.description: Adds smooth sine motion. Speed is cycles/second; choose an axis for vector properties.

Wiggle.name: Ping-Pong Oscillate
Wiggle.description: Adds linear back-and-forth motion. A full cycle takes 2 / abs(Speed) seconds; choose an axis for vectors.

Wiggle.name: Drift
Wiggle.description: Slow organic Position or Rotation motion. Speed is radians/second; Amount uses pixels or degrees. Preserves Z.

Transform.name: Randomize Scale
Transform.description: Stable random scale variation that preserves existing proportions and 2D/3D dimensions. Min/Max are percentages.

Transform.name: Maintain Stroke Width
Transform.description: Compensates current layer X/Y scale. Parent and nested shape-group scaling are not compensated; nonuniform scale is approximate.

Transform.name: Procedural Sine Path
Transform.description: Creates an open sine path. Animate Phase Degrees to move the wave.

Transform.name: Circular Orbit
Transform.description: Orbits the original position in its parent space. Speed is revolutions per second; Z is preserved.

Transform.name: Counter Rotation
Transform.description: Cancels rotation from every 2D parent. Angle Offset is subtracted from the original rotation.

Transform.name: Randomize Rotation
Transform.description: Gives duplicated layers stable random rotation in degrees.

Transform.name: Randomize Position
Transform.description: Scatters duplicates around their original Position. X/Y amounts are pixels; Z is preserved.

Transform.name: Alternate Direction
Transform.description: Offsets odd/even layers in opposite directions. Uses X for Position (pixels), or Rotation (degrees).

Transform.name: Progressive Offset — Position
Transform.description: Spaces layers progressively by composition index in pixels. Preserves Z.

Transform.name: Progressive Offset — Rotation
Transform.description: Offsets Rotation progressively by composition index. Step is degrees.

Transform.name: Progressive Offset — Scale
Transform.description: Scales duplicates progressively while preserving proportions. Step is percent per layer index.

Utility.name: Quantized Value
Utility.description: Snaps scalar or vector values to fixed increments for stepped or mechanical motion.

Utility.name: Clamp Value
Utility.description: Limits each component of the original/keyframed value to a range. Applying replaces any existing expression.

Utility.name: Random Hold
Utility.description: Holds a random scalar or vector until the next interval. Rate is changes/second; 0 freezes the random value.

Color.name: Rainbow Cycle
Color.description: Cycles hue while preserving the original alpha. Negative Speed reverses direction.

Color.name: Random Color Per Second
Color.description: Random color at Changes Per Second (default 1). Zero freezes the color; Seed changes the sequence. Preserves alpha.

Color.name: Brightness Pulse (Same Hue)
Color.description: Pulses lightness while preserving the original hue, saturation, and alpha.

Opacity.name: Flicker
Opacity.description: Stepped light/display flicker. Speed is changes/second; 0 holds a stable random opacity.

Opacity.name: Randomize Opacity
Opacity.description: Stable opacity variation for stars, crowds and texture elements.
